svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Devcontainer image and its agents
svg.desc: The image build produces a root-owned toolchain and hook configuration; the dev user runs any of five agents, each of which shells out to osf hook.

g.text: CODING AGENTS · DEV USER, INSIDE THE CONTAINER
